title: The Array of the Land of Bliss (The Amitabha Sutra)
summary: The Buddha tells Shariputra about Sukhavati, a world of bliss far to the west, where the buddha Amitayus, also called Amitabha, is teaching right now. Anyone who keeps his name in mind with an undistracted heart can be born there, and buddhas in every direction vouch for this teaching.
compare: 最大的差别是佛的名字。梵本里这位佛几乎一直叫 Amitāyus（无量寿），只在解释名字的那一段出现一次 Amitābha（无量光）。鸠摩罗什把两者统一音译成「阿弥陀」，借的是两个名字共有的 amita（无量），一个词同时包住了「光」与「寿」，后来「阿弥陀佛」成了中文世界最熟悉的佛号。本站英文和白话照梵文，该写 Amitayus 就写 Amitayus，读者能看出原文其实以「寿」为主。经名也一样：梵文叫《极乐庄严》，以国土命名；鸠摩罗什叫《阿弥陀经》，以佛命名。
第二个差别在修行方法。梵文说听到名号后「放在心上」（manasikāra），一夜到七夜心不散乱，没有说出声念。鸠摩罗什译成「执持名号」「一心不乱」，又把「夜」改成「日」。「执持名号」后来成了中国净土宗「持名念佛」的经典依据。英文 keeps it in mind 贴着梵文走，读不出「持名」的味道；同样，经中鸟声让人「念佛、念法、念僧」，原文也只是「想起、忆念」。
第三，鸠摩罗什的译本比梵本短得多，也加了不少东西。删的：五色莲花删成四色，每种的四层重复删成两层；「佛国就是由这样的功德庄严装点起来的」这句副歌只留下一部分；梵天、几位菩萨、乾闼婆没有出现。加的：池上的楼阁、六种鸟（梵本只有三种）、「八圣道分」、「诸菩萨亦复如是」、舌相「遍覆三千大千世界」与「说诚实言」、结尾的「作礼而去」。本站英文照梵文保留全部重复，所以英文明显比鸠摩罗什本长。
第四是几个容易被字面误读的词。vyūha 是「一整套华美的陈设」，古汉语「庄严」也是这个意思，但现代中文读者会读成「严肃」；kulaputra 是「好家族的儿子」，「善男子」听起来像在说品德；kaṣāya 是水底的浑浊沉渣，「浊」很贴切，英文用 murk；koṭi（一千万）被对成「亿」，于是有了「十万亿佛土」，英文按实际数目写 a million million。
最后是音译与意译。鸠摩罗什对一些核心词用音译：「阿鞞跋致」（不退转）、「阿耨多罗三藐三菩提」（无上正等正觉），佛名里也有「达摩佛」这样音译、意译混用的例子；而六方佛名大多意译，但和梵本对照，个数、次序都有出入。英文这次反过来：佛名保留梵文发音，概念一律意译，读者能直接看懂意思，却看不出那些名字原来的含义。

verses.en: Homage to the All-Knowing One!

cmp.note: 梵本开头先礼敬「一切智者」，也就是全知的佛。鸠摩罗什本没有这一句，直接从「如是我闻」开始。

verses.en: This is what I heard. Once the Blessed One was staying at Shravasti, in the Jeta Grove, in the park of Anathapindada, together with a great community of monks, twelve hundred and fifty of them. They were elders and great disciples, well known and known for their higher powers, and every one of them was an arhat: the elder Shariputra, Mahamaudgalyayana, Mahakashyapa, Mahakapphina, Mahakatyayana, Mahakaushthila, Revata, Shuddhipanthaka, Nanda, Ananda, Rahula, Gavampati, Bharadvaja, Kalodayin, Vakkula, and Aniruddha. These were there, and many other great disciples, and many bodhisattvas, great beings, as well.

cmp.note: 梵文的说法是「第十三个百少一半」，也就是一千二百五十，这是印度古代常见的计数法。英文和中文都直接写成整数，读不出原来绕一下的说法。
梵文这里是个文字游戏：abhijñā（神通）和 abhijñāta（有名的）连在一起，意思是「以神通而闻名」。鸠摩罗什只译了「众所知识」（大家都认识），神通那一半没有译出来。

verses.en: Among them were Manjushri, who had become a young prince; the bodhisattva Ajita; the bodhisattva Gandhahastin; the bodhisattva Nityodyukta; and the bodhisattva Anikshiptadhura. These were there, and many other bodhisattvas, great beings. So were Shakra, lord of the gods, and Brahma, lord of this world, and with them countless other gods, hundreds of thousands of nayutas of them.

cmp.note: 字面是「成为童子的」，指年轻的王子。鸠摩罗什译成「法王子」，多加了「法王」二字，把他说成佛（法王）的继承人；白话按梵文写「童子」。
梵本在帝释之外还有娑婆世界之主梵天，菩萨也多一位「不休息菩萨」（anikṣiptadhura）。鸠摩罗什本只留下帝释（释提桓因），这两位都没有出现。

verses.en: Then the Blessed One spoke to the venerable Shariputra: "Shariputra, far to the west of here, past a million million buddha-lands, there is a world called Sukhavati, the Land of Bliss. A Tathagata named Amitayus, a worthy one, perfectly awakened, lives there right now. He stays there, carries on his life there, and teaches the Dharma. What do you think, Shariputra: why is that world called Sukhavati? Shariputra, in the world Sukhavati beings have no pain of body and no pain of mind; the sources of happiness there are beyond measure. That is why that world is called Sukhavati."

cmp.note: 这部梵本里，这位佛几乎一直叫 Amitāyus（无量寿），只在后面解释名字时出现一次 Amitābha（无量光）。鸠摩罗什统一音译成「阿弥陀」，借两个名字共有的 amita（无量），一个词同时盖住了「光」和「寿」。英文照梵文写 Amitayus，白话写「无量寿」。
「十万个俱胝」。一俱胝（koṭi）是一千万，算下来是一万亿，英文写 a million million。鸠摩罗什把 koṭi 对成「亿」，所以写「十万亿」；古代「亿」的大小本来就不固定，数字只是在说「极远」。
梵文分开说：没有身体的苦，也没有心里的苦。鸠摩罗什合成「无有众苦，但受诸乐」，身、心两种苦的区分不见了。

verses.en: Moreover, Shariputra, the world Sukhavati is adorned and enclosed on every side by seven rows of railings, seven rows of palm trees, and nets of little bells. It is colorful and lovely to look at, made of four precious things: gold, silver, beryl, and crystal. Shariputra, such are the splendid arrays of good qualities that adorn that buddha-land.

cmp.note: 这句是全经反复出现的副歌。vyūha 是「排列、陈设、一整套布置」，英文写 arrays；鸠摩罗什译「功德庄严」，「庄严」在古汉语是「装饰得很华美」，现代中文却多半理解成「严肃」，意思差得很远。经名 Sukhāvatīvyūha 的 vyūha 就是这个词。
梵文是「挂满小铃铛的网」。鸠摩罗什只写「罗网」，铃铛不见了；而他把「多罗树行列」（tālapaṅkti，一种棕榈树）写成泛称的「行树」。

verses.en: Moreover, Shariputra, in the world Sukhavati there are lotus ponds made of seven precious things: gold, silver, beryl, crystal, red pearl, emerald, and, as the seventh, mother-of-pearl. They are filled with water that has eight good qualities; their banks are level with the water, so full that a crow could drink from them; and their beds are strewn with golden sand. On all four sides of these ponds are four stairways, colorful and lovely to look at, made of four precious things: gold, silver, beryl, and crystal. And all around the ponds grow jewel trees, colorful and lovely to look at, made of seven precious things: gold, silver, beryl, crystal, red pearl, emerald, and, as the seventh, mother-of-pearl.

cmp.note: 梵本说池子四周长着七宝树。鸠摩罗什本这里换成「上有楼阁」，楼阁是梵本这一段没有的，宝树倒没有译。
这两种宝物的身份历来说法不一。aśmagarbha 字面是「石中所孕」，多认为是祖母绿，白话写「玛瑙」；musāragalva 汉译「砗磲」，是一种大贝壳，英文用 mother-of-pearl（珍珠母）来近似。七宝的清单在不同译本里本来就不统一。

verses.en: In those ponds grow lotuses: blue ones, blue in color, glowing blue, blue to the eye; yellow ones, yellow in color, glowing yellow, yellow to the eye; red ones, red in color, glowing red, red to the eye; white ones, white in color, glowing white, white to the eye; many-colored ones, many-colored in hue, glowing many colors, many-colored to the eye; each as wide around as a cart wheel. Shariputra, such are the splendid arrays of good qualities that adorn that buddha-land.

cmp.note: 梵本有五种莲花，第五种是杂色的，每种都用「是…色、…颜色、放…光、看上去…」四层重复来写。鸠摩罗什删成四种、每种两层（青色青光），又加了梵本没有的「微妙香洁」。英文保留了全部重复。

verses.en: Moreover, Shariputra, in that buddha-land heavenly instruments are always playing, and the great earth is golden and delightful. Three times each night and three times each day, a rain of heavenly mandarava flowers falls there. The beings born there go to other worlds, all before a single morning meal, and pay homage to a million million buddhas. They shower each Tathagata with a million million showers of flowers, and then come back to that same world for their daytime rest. Shariputra, such are the splendid arrays of good qualities that adorn that buddha-land.

cmp.note: 梵文说「在一顿早饭之前」去礼佛，回来是为了「白天的休息」。鸠摩罗什改成「常以清旦」出门、「即以食时」回来「饭食经行」，还加了「衣裓盛众妙华」（用衣襟兜着花），画面更像中土僧人的日常。

verses.en: Moreover, Shariputra, in that buddha-land there are geese, cranes, and peacocks. Three times each night and three times each day they gather and sing together, each in its own voice. As they sing, out comes the sound of the five faculties, the five powers, and the seven factors of awakening. When the people there hear that sound, their minds turn to the Buddha, turn to the Dharma, and turn to the Sangha. What do you think, Shariputra: are these beings born as animals? You should not see it that way. Why not? Shariputra, in that buddha-land even the names of the hells, the animal realm, and the world of Yama do not exist. Rather, these flocks of birds were conjured by the Tathagata Amitayus, and they give voice to the sound of the Dharma.

cmp.note: 梵本只有三种鸟：天鹅、鹤、孔雀。鸠摩罗什列了六种：白鹄、孔雀、鹦鹉、舍利、迦陵频伽、共命之鸟，多出来的几种是他补的，鹤反而没有。讲的法他也多加了一项「八圣道分」。
manasikāra 是「把注意力放到…上、想起」。英文写 their minds turn to the Buddha，白话写「对佛的忆念」；鸠摩罗什的「念佛」在这里也是这个意思，和后来「口念佛号」的念佛不是一回事。

verses.en: Shariputra, such are the splendid arrays of good qualities that adorn that buddha-land.

Moreover, Shariputra, in that buddha-land, when the wind stirs those rows of palm trees and those nets of bells, a sweet and lovely sound comes forth. Shariputra, it is just like the sweet and lovely sound of a heavenly instrument with a million million parts, played by skilled musicians: just so, Shariputra, a sweet and lovely sound comes forth from those rows of palm trees and nets of bells when the wind stirs them. When the people there hear that sound, mindfulness of the Buddha settles in their bodies, mindfulness of the Dharma settles in their bodies, and mindfulness of the Sangha settles in their bodies. Shariputra, such are the splendid arrays of good qualities that adorn that buddha-land.

cmp.note: 梵文是「一件有百千万亿个部件的天乐器」，是一件乐器。鸠摩罗什写「百千种乐同时俱作」，变成很多件乐器一起演奏。
梵文说对佛、法、僧的忆念「在身体里安住」，像是整个人被它充满。鸠摩罗什写成「自然生念佛、念法、念僧之心」，落在「心」上，「身」这一层没有了。

verses.en: What do you think, Shariputra: why is that Tathagata called Amitayus? Shariputra, the length of life of that Tathagata and of the people there is beyond measure. That is why that Tathagata is called Amitayus, Infinite Life. And, Shariputra, it has been ten eons since that Tathagata awoke to unsurpassed, perfect awakening.

What do you think, Shariputra: why is that Tathagata called Amitabha? Shariputra, that Tathagata's light is unobstructed in every buddha-land. That is why that Tathagata is called Amitabha, Infinite Light.

cmp.note: 梵本先解释「无量寿」、再解释「无量光」；鸠摩罗什本次序相反，先讲光再讲寿，两段都归到「阿弥陀」一个名字下。他还加了「照十方国」，梵文只说光在一切佛国「不受阻碍」。

verses.en: And, Shariputra, that Tathagata has a community of disciples beyond measure, pure arhats, whose number is not easy to tell. Shariputra, such are the splendid arrays of good qualities that adorn that buddha-land.

cmp.note: 梵本这里只讲声闻弟子。鸠摩罗什在后面加了一句「诸菩萨，亦复如是」，把菩萨也算进来；梵本要到下一段才讲菩萨。

verses.en: Moreover, Shariputra, the beings born in the buddha-land of the Tathagata Amitayus are pure bodhisattvas who can no longer turn back, bound to just one more birth. Shariputra, it is not easy to tell the number of those bodhisattvas; they can only be reckoned as 'immeasurable, beyond counting.' So, Shariputra, beings should make a vow to be born in that buddha-land. Why? Because there one comes together with good people like these. Shariputra, beings are not born in the buddha-land of the Tathagata Amitayus through some small root of goodness.

cmp.note: 「不会再退转的」。英文和白话都意译；鸠摩罗什音译成「阿鞞跋致」，读者若不查就看不懂。
「只被一生系住」，即再生一次就成佛。梵文说生到那里的菩萨全都如此；鸠摩罗什写「其中多有一生补处」，变成「很多是」，范围缩小了。

verses.en: Shariputra, any son or daughter of good family who hears the name of that Blessed One, the Tathagata Amitayus, and having heard it keeps it in mind, for one night, or two nights, or three nights, or four nights, or five nights, or six nights, or seven nights, keeps it in mind with an undistracted mind: when that son or daughter of good family comes to die, at the hour of death that Tathagata Amitayus, surrounded by his community of disciples and with his host of bodhisattvas going before him, will stand in front of them, and they will die with a mind free of confusion. Having died, they will be born in the buddha-land of that same Tathagata Amitayus, in the world Sukhavati.

cmp.note: 梵文是「放在心上、专注地想着」那个名号，没有说出声念。鸠摩罗什译成「执持名号」，后来中国净土宗据此发展出「持名念佛」（口念阿弥陀佛）。英文 keeps it in mind 贴近梵文，读不出「持名」的意思。
梵文以「夜」计数：一夜、两夜……七夜。鸠摩罗什改成「一日、二日……七日」，更合中文习惯，意思没变。
字面是「好家族的儿子」，kula 是家族、出身。中文「善男子」容易读成「品行好的男人」；英文 son of good family 保留了「出身」这层原意。

verses.en: Therefore, Shariputra, it is because I see this benefit that I say this: in all earnestness, sons and daughters of good family should set their heart's vow on that buddha-land.

Shariputra, just as I am now praising that world, in the same way, Shariputra, in the east there are the Tathagata named Akshobhya, the Tathagata named Merudhvaja, the Tathagata named Mahameru, the Tathagata named Meruprabhasa, the Tathagata named Manjudhvaja. Led by these, Shariputra, there are buddhas, blessed ones, as many as the grains of sand in the Ganges River in the east. Each covers their own buddha-land with their tongue and makes this declaration: "Trust this teaching called 'Praise of Inconceivable Virtues, Embraced by All Buddhas.'"

cmp.note: 「用舌头盖住」。古印度相传，舌头长到能盖住脸的人不会说谎，所以这是在用身体发誓。梵本说诸佛盖住「自己的佛国」，鸠摩罗什写「出广长舌相，遍覆三千大千世界」，又加「说诚实言」，把「这是真话」的意思点明了。
parigraha 是「抓住、收下、护持」。白话写「摄受」，英文写 embraced；鸠摩罗什译「护念」，侧重「惦记、保护」，经名《一切诸佛所护念经》就从这里来。

verses.en: In the same way, in the south there are the Tathagata named Chandrasuryapradipa, the Tathagata named Yashahprabha, the Tathagata named Maharchiskandha, the Tathagata named Merupradipa, the Tathagata named Anantavirya. Led by these, Shariputra, there are buddhas, blessed ones, as many as the grains of sand in the Ganges River in the south. Each covers their own buddha-land with their tongue and makes this declaration: "Trust this teaching called 'Praise of Inconceivable Virtues, Embraced by All Buddhas.'"

cmp.note: 「大火焰聚」。skandha 既是「一堆、一聚」，也是「肩膀」。白话取「聚」，鸠摩罗什取「肩」，译成「大焰肩佛」，同一个字两种读法。

verses.en: In the same way, in the west there are the Tathagata named Amitayus, the Tathagata named Amitaskandha, the Tathagata named Amitadhvaja, the Tathagata named Mahaprabha, the Tathagata named Maharatnaketu, the Tathagata named Shuddharashmiprabha. Led by these, Shariputra, there are buddhas, blessed ones, as many as the grains of sand in the Ganges River in the west. Each covers their own buddha-land with their tongue and makes this declaration: "Trust this teaching called 'Praise of Inconceivable Virtues, Embraced by All Buddhas.'"

cmp.note: 西方诸佛里第一位就是 Amitāyus。鸠摩罗什在这里没有音译成「阿弥陀」，而是意译「无量寿佛」；他列了七个佛名，比梵本多一个「大明佛」。

verses.en: In the same way, in the north there are the Tathagata named Maharchiskandha, the Tathagata named Vaishvanaranirghosha, the Tathagata named Dundubhisvaranirghosha, the Tathagata named Dushpradharsha, the Tathagata named Adityasambhava, the Tathagata named Jaleniprabha, the Tathagata named Prabhakara. Led by these, Shariputra, there are buddhas, blessed ones, as many as the grains of sand in the Ganges River in the north. Each covers their own buddha-land with their tongue and makes this declaration: "Trust this teaching called 'Praise of Inconceivable Virtues, Embraced by All Buddhas.'"

In the same way, below there are the Tathagata named Simha, the Tathagata named Yashas, the Tathagata named Yashahprabhasa, the Tathagata named Dharma, the Tathagata named Dharmadhara, the Tathagata named Dharmadhvaja. Led by these, Shariputra, there are buddhas, blessed ones, as many as the grains of sand in the Ganges River in the direction below. Each covers their own buddha-land with their tongue and makes this declaration: "Trust this teaching called 'Praise of Inconceivable Virtues, Embraced by All Buddhas.'"

cmp.note: 名叫「法」的佛。鸠摩罗什其他佛名多半意译（法幢、持法），唯独这一位音译成「达摩佛」，一个列表里音译、意译混用。

verses.en: In the same way, above there are the Tathagata named Brahmaghosha, the Tathagata named Nakshatraraja, the Tathagata named Indraketudhvajaraja, the Tathagata named Gandhottama, the Tathagata named Gandhaprabhasa, the Tathagata named Maharchiskandha, the Tathagata named Ratnakusumasampushpitagatra, the Tathagata named Salendraraja, the Tathagata named Ratnotpalashri, the Tathagata named Sarvarthadarsha, the Tathagata named Sumerukalpa. Led by these, Shariputra, there are buddhas, blessed ones, as many as the grains of sand in the Ganges River in the direction above. Each covers their own buddha-land with their tongue and makes this declaration: "Trust this teaching called 'Praise of Inconceivable Virtues, Embraced by All Buddhas.'"

What do you think, Shariputra: why is this teaching called 'Embraced by All Buddhas'? Shariputra, any sons or daughters of good family who hear the name of this teaching and keep in mind the names of those buddhas, blessed ones, will all be embraced by the buddhas, and will never turn back from unsurpassed, perfect awakening. Therefore, Shariputra, have faith, trust, and do not doubt me or those buddhas, blessed ones.

cmp.note: 「无上的、完全正确的觉悟」。英文和白话都意译；鸠摩罗什音译成「阿耨多罗三藐三菩提」，这个长音译词后来成了汉传佛教的固定说法。

verses.en: Shariputra, any sons or daughters of good family who will set, or have set, or are now setting their heart's vow on the buddha-land of that Blessed One, the Tathagata Amitayus, will all never turn back from unsurpassed, perfect awakening, and they will be born, or have been born, or are now being born, in that buddha-land. Therefore, Shariputra, sons and daughters of good family who have faith should raise in their hearts the vow for that buddha-land.

Shariputra, just as I am now praising the inconceivable virtues of those buddhas, blessed ones, in the same way, Shariputra, those buddhas, blessed ones, praise my inconceivable virtues: 'The Blessed One Shakyamuni, king of the Shakyas, has done something very hard. In the Saha world he awoke to unsurpassed, perfect awakening, and taught a Dharma the whole world finds hard to believe, in a time clouded by five kinds of murk: a murky age, murky beings, murky views, murky lifespans, and murky passions.'

cmp.note: 原义是浑浊的沉渣，像水底的泥。中文「浊」很贴切，英文用 murk（浑浊）来对。鸠摩罗什另加「五浊恶世」这个总名，把「恶」字也加了进去；他列的次序也和梵本不同。

verses.en: For me too, Shariputra, it is supremely hard that in the Saha world I awoke to unsurpassed, perfect awakening and taught a Dharma the whole world finds hard to believe, in a time of murky beings, murky views, murky passions, murky lifespans, and a murky age.

So said the Blessed One, his heart glad. The venerable Shariputra, those monks, those bodhisattvas, and the world with its gods, humans, asuras, and gandharvas rejoiced at what the Blessed One had said.

cmp.note: 梵文说是佛自己「心中欢喜」地说完。鸠摩罗什没有译这一点，只写听众「欢喜信受，作礼而去」，后半句是他按汉译佛经惯例补的；菩萨和乾闼婆也没有列出。

verses.en: This completes the Mahayana sutra called The Array of Sukhavati.

cmp.note: 梵文经名是「极乐世界的庄严陈设」，以那片国土命名。鸠摩罗什改名《佛说阿弥陀经》，以那位佛命名，重心从「地方」移到「佛」。
